title: Generate a Jira-ready task from a local product brief
problem: Product ideas currently become vague Jira tasks that require repeated clarification before engineering can begin.
desired_outcome: A local command produces one structured, reviewable Jira task draft without writing to Jira.
business_value: Reduce refinement time while improving task clarity, testability, and delivery confidence.
constraints: The first version must be dry-run only
No credentials or private Jira metadata may enter the repository
The generation loop must be bounded
known_context: Use a validated Pydantic output model
non_goals: Creating or updating Jira issues in the first vertical slice
Running an autonomous multi-agent group chat
